g.title: cluster_store
g.text: XDG store ~/.local/share/cheese/<project_key>/work/<work_id>/ (JSON files, flock, atomic promote, no SQLite)

g.title: cluster_unused
g.text: exists in the schema package, NOT used by the record

g.title: record
g.text: identity: work_id, slug, title, created, project_key
decision_dossier[] DecisionFork {fork, options[{option, evidence[], breaks}], prior_leaning}
status = DERIVED (gated if any active question/blocker has blocks_continuation)

g.title: record->aref
g.text: ArtifactLink only pins a repo-relative path;
cannot pin XDG, a wiki page, or a milknado node

g.title: note
g.text: what milknado's adoption contract links today

g.title: verbs
g.text: read: show, resolve, lint, list, log, turns, schema, validate, handoff

g.title: phases
g.text: cook / press / age / cure / plate / affinage
commit their handoff as a revision

g.title: cont
g.text: stops on gated | ambiguous | legacy | foreign
